events.title: Nude Figure Drawing at Unkindness Art
events.description: Ongoing nude figure drawing series (18+ only, valid photo ID required at door) on the last Wednesday of every month, 7:45-10pm. September session is a short-pose session with a single model. Tickets nonrefundable and must be purchased in advance; no guaranteed door tickets. Late entry not allowed once session starts at 8pm.
